title: Geometric-generic closed-support and internal-Hom exchange over arbitrary algebraically closed fields
statement:
Let $F$ be any algebraically closed field, let $N\geq1$ be invertible in $F$, and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $NA=0$. Let $B$ be a smooth integral finite-type $F$-scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] of dimension one [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], let $F(B)$ be the fraction field of the coordinate ring of any nonempty affine open in $B$, and let $L$ be an algebraically closed algebraic extension of $F(B)$, and put $\bar\eta=\operatorname{Spec}L$. For any finite-type $B$-scheme $T$ write $g_T:T_{\bar\eta}=T\times_B\bar\eta\to T$ for the projection [def-pc-base-change, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Work on small etale sites in ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with exact inverse image $g_T^*=g_T^{-1}$ [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Bounded constructible means bounded cohomology with constructible module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. Finite Tor amplitude has the meaning that $\mathcal H^q(K\otimes_A^LM)=0$ outside a fixed finite interval for all module sheaves $M$ in degree zero [def-kun-derived-tensor, def-kun-tor-amplitude].

Let $X$ be a separated finite-type $B$-scheme. For a closed immersion $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ and $M\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, the canonical closed-support comparison is an isomorphism
$$g_Z^*Ri^!M\xrightarrow{\sim}Ri_{\bar\eta}^!g_X^*M,$$
where $Ri^!$ is the right adjoint of closed direct image in the ordinary etale derived categories [lem-exc-closed-ambient]. Finally for bounded constructible $K$ of finite Tor amplitude and $M\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, the canonical tensor-adjoint internal-Hom comparison is an isomorphism
$$\beta_{K,M}:g_X^*R\mathcal Hom_A(K,M)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\mathcal Hom_A(g_X^*K,g_X^*M)$$
[def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. This comparison is the transpose of pulled-back evaluation: after the canonical inverse-image tensor identification, $\mathrm{ev}\circ(\beta_{K,M}\otimes 1_{g_X^*K})=g_X^*\mathrm{ev}_{K,M}$. The closed-support comparison respects adjunction counits, open restriction, and tensoring with an invertible locally constant rank-one coefficient sheaf and shifting; these are the canonical comparisons obtained from adjunction. Here invertible means a sheaf possessing a tensor inverse. No finite-field base is assumed.
